scope: Manual readability and factual pass over the remaining repository-authored story dialogue, every authored campaign branch and choice outcome, side stories, endings, and conditional First Pact/Legacy dialogue. Continues the earlier Academy/tutorial pass.
method: Read complete conversations at scene boundaries. Identical runtime variants were read once; conditional source literals were checked separately. Automated scans and tests supplement the manual pass.

otherReviewedContent: Legacy emissaries, Sage offer and all rumor alternatives
Sunscar caravan events, contracts and rally dialogue
Hollow Gate introductions and floor observations
Era chapters, clan/shrine lore and story evidence items
First Pact interiors, aftermaths, standing Court and district writs
Tower briefings and road encounter conditional dialogue
excluded: Bulk Chronicle card catalog and general equipment catalog are outside the remaining story-dialogue pass.
Creator-authored remote/admin content was not supplied and is not covered.

factualCorrections.finding: Active Poison adds HP damage when a jutsu actually spends chakra or stamina. Zero-spend casts do not trigger it. Basic attacks avoid this extra spend damage. Recommend Cleanse only when available.

Replaced claims about a fourth-turn impound deadline, forced role changes, guaranteed move locks, guaranteed assassin pivots, and targeting the loudest pet. Advice now describes the actual authored roles and ordinary moves, protection effects, reserves and matchups.
Removed invented recurring profit deposits, larger-purse choice rewards, uncharged purchases and informant-fee payouts. Existing choice traits, rewards and destinations remain intact.

Vanta no longer closes the main estate account before its chapter. Yura no longer claims to have broken her oath before that chapter. Removed a nonexistent three-night quest deadline. Aren remains alive with an altered life.
Removed an unsupported rift attack-window instruction, a nonexistent hunt conductor-cutting objective, and a floor-one reinforcement warning. No combat rules were changed.

validation.fullRunFollowUp: Three tests pinned previous wording and were updated while preserving their canon and callback checks. A renamed Mira page was reconnected to its existing close-up, expression and reveal cue. All affected files pass in the 82-test regression rerun. The unmodified runtime metrics timing test passes both tests when rerun outside the sandbox after browser load ended. The complete repository suite was not repeated after these fixes.
validation.build: passed, including generated-content verification, asset verification and bundle budgets

storyReaderBrowserChecks.note: Two finale cases were rerun successfully after replacing an assertion on retired copy with the authored choice text. Other 20 cases passed on the first run.

combatLayoutBrowserChecks.mode: Solo-PvE viewport matrix, strict capture-after checks

validation.advisoryReview: Short lines and repeated variant text were reviewed in context. Ellipses mark interrupted speech; soul/Bloodline flags include explicit denials and proper names; the first-person Echoes entries are character replies grouped by the inventory renderer. Four uncatalogued sources were inspected, including their road-nemesis and patrol providers.

changedPassages.after: You work out how Havel's fear creates the false tracks and deliberately steer his attention toward the hunters' camp. By dark, the prints lead straight through it. Oren leaves without collecting his fee.
changedPassages.reason: This story choice does not unlock a usable jutsu. Keep the effect specific to Havel and this scene.

changedPassages.before: Study how the terror lands, and practice aiming it
changedPassages.after: Use Havel's false tracks to mislead the hunters
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: What survived was the shape of the choice. Across old accounts, witnesses kept recognizing the same hundred patterns: mercy, calculation, ambition, endurance. A Legacy returns when someone freely repeats one under witness.
changedPassages.after: Later witnesses found the same kinds of choices in other people's deeds: mercy, calculation, ambition, endurance. They gave a hundred recurring patterns names. A Legacy honors someone whose actions fit one of those patterns.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: an unsigned payment reaches your camp.
changedPassages.after: an unsigned note promises you payment for the planted evidence.
changedPassages.reason: This choice does not grant an additional currency payment.

changedPassages.before: Report her to Bellis and collect the two hundred
changedPassages.after: Report her to Bellis and claim the promised informant fee
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Bellis counts out two hundred and voids her contract on the spot, penalty and all. Harrow watches you pocket it, then opens her ledger and writes something short.
changedPassages.after: Bellis records your claim for the informant fee and voids Harrow's contract on the spot. She watches you sign the report, then opens her ledger and writes something short.
changedPassages.reason: The choice records the fee claim as a story outcome, without inventing a currency deposit.

changedPassages.before: Twenty of them pooled up and dug.
changedPassages.after: Twenty of them pooled their money and hired a digging crew.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Down the wide stair, past the lamplight, something keeps a slow rhythm. It could be water. Water doesn't count.
changedPassages.after: Beyond the lamplight, a steady sound comes up the wide stair. At first it sounds like dripping water. Then you hear pauses that make it sound like someone counting.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Withheld were people of that age who refused cession, not gods. Before they left, they recorded these four locks.
changedPassages.after: The Withheld were people from that age who refused to surrender a defining choice to the Court. They recorded these four locks before they left.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: There is no Kage. There's you.
changedPassages.after: The old Kage is gone, and nobody has settled who should rule next. People are looking to you because you ended the old rule.
changedPassages.reason: Defeating a story Kage does not itself appoint the player to the live village Kage role.

changedPassages.before: Order tribunals: open hearings, published names, punishments with a ceiling.
changedPassages.after: Propose public hearings with recorded evidence and clear limits on punishment.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Kesa Volt's account is closed, but the old machinery did not stop reaching for people who still remember her.
changedPassages.after: The old machinery is still using Kesa Volt's name to reach the people who remember her.
changedPassages.reason: Available at ownProgress 5, before the level-75 estate closure.

changedPassages.before: We'll enter the recovered seal as evidence and stop further collections under that account.
changedPassages.after: We'll enter the recovered seal as evidence and stop Sesk collecting under her name.
changedPassages.reason: Recovering Sesk's seal does not close the main campaign estate account.

changedPassages.before: My mother's ridge marker was broken up for pressed flowers. Kesa Volt, reduced to resale value one more time.
changedPassages.after: Someone broke up my mother's ridge marker and sold the pieces as weights for pressing flowers. They even found a way to profit from her memorial.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Pickers carried the pieces beyond this gate. Meet me at the ridge gate with the weather still readable; we'll choose the high line or the picker road from there.
changedPassages.after: Flower pickers carried the pieces beyond this gate. Meet me at the ridge gate before the rain, and we'll choose which path to take.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The drain took a whole column of names last month. Scrubbed clean, filed under weather. My family was in that column. Reed.
changedPassages.after: Last month, the Register lost a whole column of names. The clerks blamed weather damage, but the names were deliberately scraped away. My family was in that column. Reed.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: One of those plates says Aren Reed. A boy Toma still sets a place for. Struck, filed, and marked for the burning.
changedPassages.after: One of those plates bears Aren Reed's name. They altered his life, and now they are trying to burn the record of who he used to be.
changedPassages.reason: Avoid implying Aren died or disappeared from the family; canon describes his altered life.

changedPassages.before: Leave the coat. I have spent enough nights at this gate to know when the cold is merely uncomfortable. Keep your hands free for the pages.
changedPassages.after: Do not worry about me. I have spent enough nights at this gate to manage the cold. Keep your hands free for the pages.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: I broke my oath to the Count. Kree won't recognize an arrest order from me, and his watchers know my face. I need your help reaching him.
changedPassages.after: I signed off Kree's totals for years. Now that I have challenged them, he refuses to recognize my authority. His watchers know my face. I need your help reaching him.
changedPassages.reason: Available at ownProgress 5, before Yura removes the oath mark in the level-75 chapter.

changedPassages.before: There is a man on his list right now, struck for arrears, his warmth-token confiscated. He will not last three nights without it. Kree wrote the deadline himself and posted watchers at the road.
changedPassages.after: There is a man on his list whose warmth-token was confiscated over unpaid fees. He is stranded in the cold, and Kree has posted watchers to keep him off the road.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Find Kree. Take back the struck token before the third night. Bring it here and I will put it back in the hand it was cut from myself.
changedPassages.after: Find Kree and recover the confiscated warmth-token. Bring it here, and I will return it to its owner myself.
changedPassages.reason: The quest has no three-night expiry or timed death consequence.

changedPassages.before: Go. He has already lost one night.
changedPassages.after: Go when you are ready. We need to get him out of the cold.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: 'He has already lost one night,' Yura says.
changedPassages.after: 'Come back when you can help,' Yura says.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: I sealed that shelf. I know exactly which drawer. I cannot open my own archive against my own seal without ending myself as its master. You are bound by no seal I ever set.
changedPassages.after: My seal protected that shelf, and the enforcer is using my own authorization to move the files. I cannot pretend this is someone else's mistake. Help me recover the file so I can return it publicly.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: When I break that seal, my own rules remove me as archive master. I should have broken it years ago.
changedPassages.after: Breaking that seal in public will expose what I allowed. I should have done it years ago.
changedPassages.reason: The side quest does not remove Iro from his role in later chapters.

changedPassages.before: "I took the shelf once. I will help unshelf every name on it."
changedPassages.after: "I accepted access to those files. I will help return them to the people they belong to."
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: She shows you the entry she made after you collected the two hundred: worth watching.
changedPassages.after: She shows you the entry she made after you claimed Bellis's informant fee: worth watching.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The resale marks split here.
changedPassages.after: The trails split here.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: we'll have to ask the flower crews what they carried in public.
changedPassages.after: we'll have to ask the flower pickers about my mother in front of the others.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Anchor's sound. Old cable isn't. I can splice my coil to the far eye.
changedPassages.after: The anchor is sound, but the old cable is damaged. I can attach my spare coil to the far anchor.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Post the notice at the ferry. Let the clerk walk away, and ask the canal to witness every return.
changedPassages.after: Post the notice at the ferry. Let the clerk withdraw, and ask people along the canal to witness each return.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The clerk's account walked away.
changedPassages.after: The clerk withdrew their help.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: their account still answers when challenged.
changedPassages.after: we can still check the facts they gave us.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The meter of the elders' cut finds your account within the week.
changedPassages.after: The ledger now lists you among those promised a share of the elders' profits.
changedPassages.reason: No scheduled currency payment is awarded by this ending.

changedPassages.before: The board has you at even, child. I erased the line. Show me a result before I quote another.
changedPassages.after: I won't bet on your good intentions, child. Show me what you do with that seat.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: No marked exit remains for it to collect.
changedPassages.after: No bound choices remain for the Gate to take.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Nine parts in ten go home, raw and unrehearsed, and the market survives it the hard way, fire by fire.
changedPassages.after: Most records go home without anyone preparing the owners for what they contain. Arguments break out across the market, and several end in fires.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Strike the controlling shape when it separates; Nara is alive inside its hold.
changedPassages.after: You need to defeat the shadow controlling her. Nara is still alive inside its hold.
changedPassages.reason: The encounter has no separate targeting phase or timed attack window.

changedPassages.before: Break the champion's guard pattern before its signature turn arrives.
changedPassages.after: The champion opens with two defenders. Check their protection effects before committing your strongest attack.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Menagerie locks one active position at a time. Rotate before the restraint lands and keep both positions available.
changedPassages.after: The Menagerie opens with two defenders. Check their protection effects and choose your targets before attacking.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Both assassins can strike and withdraw behind the healthiest reserve. Keep a counter ready for the pet that pivots in.
changedPassages.after: The Wardens open with two assassins. Watch their attack choices and switch injured companions into reserve when you can.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Assessors mark a pet before striking it. Rotate or change that pet's action before they use the mark.
changedPassages.after: The Assessors open with two trackers. Check the effects of their techniques before choosing your next actions.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Chorus changes the arena weather instead of attacking directly. Keep a reserve whose element answers the current weather.
changedPassages.after: The Chorus brings three sages. Watch for weather changes, and check which of your companions benefits before switching.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Wall recovers while its guard order remains unbroken. Force it to change roles before you spend your strongest turn.
changedPassages.after: The Wall brings three defenders. Check for blocks and shields before spending stamina on your strongest attacks.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Use all four companions and let the reserves answer openings the Court considers expendable.
changedPassages.after: The Echo brings one companion of each role. Use your reserves to replace injured pets or improve an elemental matchup.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The detail targets the loudest active pet first. Draw that restraint, then answer with the reserve they ignored.
changedPassages.after: The detail opens with two trackers. Check their status effects and keep a healthy reserve ready.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The auditors treat reserves as surplus. Rotate all four companions so their count cannot erase either reserve.
changedPassages.after: The auditors bring one companion of each role. Switch reserves in when an active pet needs rest or faces a poor matchup.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Order strikes whatever reaches from the front. Let the second active position finish the turn while the first draws the cut.
changedPassages.after: The Order opens with a defender and a sage. Check their protection and weather effects before choosing your attacks.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The impound completes its claim on the fourth turn. Break its formation before then.
changedPassages.after: Defeat all four companions in the impound team to stop this seizure. Switch injured pets into reserve when you can.
changedPassages.reason: The ordinary team battle has no fourth-turn claim or loss condition.

changedPassages.before: The Arbiter mirrors the roles and elements of the four you brought. Change active positions and target order before the reflection settles into your formation.
changedPassages.after: The Arbiter brings the same roles and elements as your team. Check the opposing moves and choose your active pair and targets carefully.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: I can bypass the lower lock once before the pressure trips it. Two assassins hold the inner route. When either strikes, it can withdraw behind the healthiest reserve.
changedPassages.after: I can bypass the lower lock to get you inside. Two assassins guard the inner route. Keep your reserves ready to replace injured companions.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The bypass is open and the pressure is climbing. Each assassin can strike, then put a fresh reserve in front of your answer.
changedPassages.after: The bypass is open. The Wardens start with two assassins, and they have two more companions in reserve.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Let Tam verify the seal, then cross the learning lattice without repeating your formation.
changedPassages.after: Let Tam verify the seal, then defeat the Lattice Wardens to reach the old intake.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Here the path and its bearer stop being two things. Do not flinch.
changedPassages.after: Keep proving your chosen path through the work this trial asks of you.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: You carry the name already. Now earn the right to keep it.
changedPassages.after: You carry the name already. Complete this trial to advance it.
changedPassages.reason: A failed or unfinished trial cannot remove a permanently accepted Legacy.

changedPassages.before: The account closed. The reason stayed.
changedPassages.after: Sesk can no longer collect under Kesa's name.
changedPassages.reason: The level-58 side quest does not close the level-75 estate account.

changedPassages.before: Take a water seal and close from the rock side.
changedPassages.after: Approach the watch from the sheltered side of the rocks.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Cut the conductor first, then bring the beast down away from the road crews.
changedPassages.after: Bring the beast down before it reaches the road crews.
changedPassages.reason: The hunt has no separate conductor-cutting objective.

changedPassages.before: You claim custody in a voice that carries down the ravine, under your seal and pending your report. The leader objects that the tower's execution writ outranks a field arrest. The camp medic spits at your boots, then produces the rescued slates and demands they be entered as evidence. The squad leader refuses to leave the prisoners in your custody. He orders his soldiers to attack.
changedPassages.after: You take the camp into custody under your seal, pending a hearing. The medic demands you enter the rescued slates as evidence. The squad leader says the tower's execution order outranks your arrest. He refuses to leave the prisoners with you and orders his soldiers to attack.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The sealed unit waits on its witness. The word is yours, and the paper is wrong, and the paper is signed by the man who carries shepherds home.
changedPassages.after: The purge unit is waiting for you to authorize the sweep. The order falsely names nineteen civilians as targets. Kael signed it, the same man who has carried injured shepherds home.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: Take the first platform before their relief squad arrives.
changedPassages.after: Defeat the outriders to secure the first platform.
changedPassages.reason: Floor one has no reinforcement wave or timer.

changedPassages.before: The Court opens the west gate and tries to split your formation by offering one companion the exit you promised.
changedPassages.after: The Court argues that letting a companion leave puts the other three at risk. It wants you to promise obedience on their behalf.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Court repeats your reason as an order and shapes its opening exchange around the response it expects.
changedPassages.after: The Court says a shared reason is too uncertain to rely on. It wants your companions to follow orders even when they disagree.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

changedPassages.before: The Court repeats every disagreement Vey recorded and uses each one to pull your four companions toward a different position.
changedPassages.after: The Court treats each recorded disagreement as evidence that your team cannot be trusted. It wants Vey to replace those entries with a pledge of obedience.
changedPassages.reason: Make the meaning explicit and natural in context.

Mira waits under the ridge gate with two coils over one shoulder and the weather slate under her arm. Objective: Choose the high cable line or the lower flower-picker road.
The old span hangs in two wet lengths above a narrow cut in the ridge. Objective: Rig the crossing with Mira's dry coil.
A fallen signal stone has split the high cairn, exposing a packet under its base. Objective: Recover Kesa's marker pieces and pressed flower.
The lower shelter leans into the ridge, its storm rail dragging loose in the wash. Objective: Repair the rail, then ask the picker crews about Kesa's marker.
Fresh runoff has opened the low cairn and left a waxed packet caught between its stones. Objective: Recover Kesa's marker pieces and pressed flower.
Conditional pages retain their trait gates.
Historical save without recorded field route.
Toma stands where the ash carts leave the village, a clamp bag in one hand and a folded oilcloth in the other. Objective: Choose whether to repair the footbridge first or follow the fresh cart trail.
The center plank has dropped below the handrail, and footprints still cross it in both directions. Objective: Fit Toma's offcuts and clamp the stringer before continuing.
Rainwater combs the channel reeds, and pale cedar edges show where the current has gathered them. Objective: Recover the scattered cedar plates without tearing their burned names.
Fresh cart ruts vanish among charcoal sledges, each runner black with the same ash. Objective: Find which cart carried the cedar plates toward the sluice.
The stopped sluice has caught a fan of black silt, bark, and pale cedar fragments. Objective: Recover and wrap the cedar plates, then return to the footbridge.
The recovered plates rest above the flood line while Toma sets a lamp beneath the failed span. Objective: Finish the bridge repair before returning the cedar plates.
Conditional pages retain their trait gates.
Historical save without recorded field route.
Sova has set one lamp-oil jar between the wall watch and the lower-road cooks. Objective: Negotiate whether to divide the oil or keep the lower stove lit until dawn.
Three ridge lamps burn at half wick while the lower-road chimney gives one thin line of smoke. Objective: Pair the watch and kitchen crews for a low-light search.
Low lamps pick out waxed page edges where the gully folds toward the ridge. Objective: Recover the true roll pages with the paired crews.
The broth stove burns steadily while watchers, cooks, and families crowd around a map on the kneading table. Objective: Mark the storm's drift and organize a daylight search.
Morning throws thin shadows from waxed pages buried edge-up along the mapped lee. Objective: Recover the true roll pages in daylight.
Conditional pages retain their trait gates.
Historical save without recorded field route.
Nyx waits beside a blank public notice while an unseen booth clerk watches from behind a shutter. Objective: Choose a protected source route or an open call for the ledger pages.
A decoy parcel waits on the east rail while one fresh wax thumbprint points west. Objective: Draw the buyer's watcher toward the decoy and follow the source's private mark.
A tarred parcel rests above the tide line, sealed with the booth clerk's witnessed mark. Objective: Recover the ledger pages and preserve the clerk's sealed account.

Nyx's notice, marked with a wax print of her ledger's stamp, hangs under the ferry lamp, surrounded by people pretending they stopped for the tide. Objective: Receive public page returns without claiming the protected clerk's testimony.
The abandoned booth is open on all sides, its counter covered in ledger pages and waiting witnesses. Objective: Reassemble the ledger under the public chain of custody.
Conditional pages retain their trait gates.
Historical save without recorded field route.
